items.markdown:
Here are notable AI consulting firms and technology providers in Saudi Arabia that specialize in `strategic AI advisory, digital roadmaps, and full-scale implementation`:

- **[Tech Partner](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/top-20-ai-consulting-firms-saudi-arabia-how-choose-right-kochar-k2jze)** (Riyadh) – Blends strategic enterprise consulting with technical execution. They specialize in deploying scalable AI platforms, system integrations, and data-driven optimization for heavy industries like oil & gas, fintech, and public services.[[1]](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/top-20-ai-consulting-firms-saudi-arabia-how-choose-right-kochar-k2jze)
- **[Ozone Technology](https://www.ozonetech.com.sa/artificial-intelligence-solutions-consulting)** (Saudi Arabia) – A KSA-based tech and consulting firm focusing on artificial intelligence, data modernization, and cloud transformations. They assist enterprises with custom generative AI strategies and modern AWS-powered analytics infrastructure.[[1]](https://www.ozonetech.com.sa/artificial-intelligence-solutions-consulting)
- **[Tharwah](https://consulting.tharwah.net/technology-and-ai-advisory/)** (Riyadh) – Offers dedicated technology and AI advisory services, including AI readiness assessments, digital maturity audits, AI transformation planning, and governance frameworks for responsible AI deployment.[[1]](https://consulting.tharwah.net/technology-and-ai-advisory/)
- **IBM Consulting Saudi Arabia** (Riyadh) – A heavyweight global enterprise choice with a major regional presence in Riyadh. Ideal for large-scale operations, government entities, and highly regulated sectors (like banking and healthcare) requiring hybrid cloud architectures, automation, and enterprise-grade AI integration via platforms like watsonx.
- **[Foxcode](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/top-20-ai-consulting-firms-saudi-arabia-how-choose-right-kochar-k2jze)** (Saudi Arabia) – An emerging agile player well-suited for startups and mid-market enterprises looking for rapid business intelligence, data engineering, and tailored AI chatbot development.[[1]](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/top-20-ai-consulting-firms-saudi-arabia-how-choose-right-kochar-k2jze)

If you can share:

- Your **industry or sector** 
- Whether you need a **boutique local advisor** or a **large enterprise system integrator** 

I can help narrow down which firm best fits your **specific project scope and budget**.
